notes.title: Super Jagua Trading Cards released!
notes.notes:
Celebrating the two month anniversary of the game's launch, the latest update introduces Steam Trading Cards. The set features 8 cards with matching icons, emoticons, and backgrounds.
This has been a hugely requested feature for the game, so I am happy to finally deliver it to thank the community for all of its support.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26235976/e5ae06e97658c6b734a5d11d5092c14c8335c971.png[/img]
